summary: host.configure requires one transactional host authority for immutable configuration versions and the default pointer, session-bound CAS/settlement, protected credential-reference validation, trusted runtime resolution and complete backup/restore. A configuration saved successfully is not a qualified/connected runtime. No public Artifact/REPORT label supplies configuration authority.

confirmed_gaps.fact: DecodeEnvelope requires epoch on every configure payload, blocking valid host-level first configuration. Host-level dispatch admits configure but handleWrite has no implementation. Conditional session CAS must replace the unconditional presence check.
Host facts start with ConfigRevision0 and nil ModelConfigs/CredentialSumm; host.status projects them directly rather than reading durable configuration and vault metadata.

setModel sends local current revision instead of next revision; relies on locally asserted settled-run text; uses v2Call where ACK/IN_PROGRESS return0; then writes model/revision without typed ConfigureResult or current snapshot verification. Local config lacks a distinct model_config_ref.

Model ref resolves only via static coordinator Routes and current qualified profile. Provider dispatch additionally scans static Providers and matches exact frozen model config/route/credential revision. Merely saving a config row cannot make it runnable.

Current replay key is principal/project/operation/command_id, broader than frozen principal+command_id logical identity. Host configuration must not permit cross-session/project/method command reuse to perform a second mutation.

Native credential replace and in-process ImportCredential revoke the supplied prior ref without checking its provider matches the replacement first. Vault metadata has provider but no per-record principal; current Vault authority relies on the verified single OS-user host directory. The full boundary must verify that host principal and exact provider, never arbitrary vault path/reference.

putOpaque writes only current domain_objects and allows updates by revision. Backup inventory hashes these rows, but normal restore validates domain_versions against frozen entities; typed old21→22 compatibility permits only four existing opaque kinds. Adding an opaque config label alone provides neither immutable history nor typed restore guarantees.

recommended_storage.choice: Numbered0023_host_model_configuration.sql plus exact schema22→23 isolated upgrade; recommended for explicit storage-version/backup compatibility, not because SQL makes public labels trustworthy.
tables: host_model_configurations: immutable rows keyed opaque model_config_ref; owner_root/principal, config_revision, exact normalized ConfigurePayload canonical bytes/hash, operation scope fingerprint, created_at, originating command_id/request_hash. UNIQUE(owner_root,principal,config_revision). Append-only update/delete triggers. Credential ref only; no credential plaintext/wrapped bytes/material digest.

host_model_config_heads: owner_root/principal primary key, current_revision and default_model_config_ref; CAS update previous_revision→next_revision in same command transaction. Head references immutable configuration row and owner. Initial revision0 has no configuration.

host_model_runtime_bindings: immutable configuration ref/hash→project/runtime registration/profile VersionRef/qualification receipt refs/execution template/core-build/bundle/credential revision. Stored binding is usable only after rechecking existing canonical qualification/admission and live credential authority. Never a Boolean ready flag. No copying old qualification to a changed tuple.

client_command_identities: principal+command_id unique key and complete canonical request hash plus original project/method receipt locator. New commands register identity and existing idempotency row in the same transaction; old journal is retained and checked for legacy identities, with ambiguous old keys refused rather than rewritten. Migration must not silently choose among old conflicting records.
recommended_storage.migration_constraints: 0023 must be additive and independently hash-pinned. Do not alter0021/0022/next_v24_sessions.sql or frozen domain/public schema. Numbered migration can run before additive client_sessions is installed: do not reference that table in DDL requiring it at migration time; configuration handlers explicitly require current client schema. No global migration bypass. Fresh empty DB may initialize23 through existing discovery; populated22 uses matching-source backup/drain and isolated staged restore. Source21 follows existing exact21→22 then explicit22→23, with both original receipts retained.
recommended_storage.opaque_alternative: Technically possible only with private exact kinds, per-version immutable IDs, typed readers checking principal/hash/shape, immutable history separate from mutable head, source-only private constructors, forbidden public insertion, complete typed backup/restore inventory and command replay invariants. Existing putOpaque permits row replacement and has no append-only version guard; existing upgrade four-kind whitelist cannot be widened generically. This alternative is not approved here and does not avoid migration/compatibility proof by calling new rows operational. Numbered23 is the proposed complete path.

command_state_machine: Authenticate current non-revoked principal and host-owned local client binding before new execution. OWNER plus same verified local host authority is required for changing defaults or session model; project-scoped calls also require original project grant. Remote supervision/READER/foreign principal cannot acquire local host settings authority by supplying client_id/epoch. Reading old receipts still requires authenticated access to their owner/scope.

At command entry query principal+command_id identity before mutable CAS. Exact canonical complete request replays the original durable result, including old executed epoch, without rechecking it into a second action; changed payload/method/project/session/epoch under same ID is COMMAND_ID_CONFLICT. Consult existing legacy idempotency rows before inserting the new identity. Ambiguous legacy keys fail closed and remain intact.

Read head revision R and parse strict frozen ConfigurePayload. New mutation requires payload.config_revision=R+1, first1. Missing/skipped/stale revision or same revision with different config/scope fingerprint is CONFIG_CONFLICT. Same revision/content alone must not authorize changing a different session; the target scope is bound. Exact historical retry returns its original receipt, never rewinds the current head.

Validate provider driver and endpoint locally only: exact model_id, URL without credentials/query/fragment, supported TLS origin or explicitly FIXTURE-only loopback, no redirect/discovery/fallback. credential_ref may be null by schema; saving an uncredentialed configuration is possible but cannot satisfy credential-required LIVE admission. A provided ref must be well-formed, current same-host owner/provider metadata and AVAILABLE; distinguish MISSING/REVOKED without disclosing material. Saving never probes the network.

Host-level configure uses null session/revision/epoch and updates only the new-session default. Session-targeted configure requires project/session expected_revision/writer_epoch/current client+lease and owner checks in the same transaction. Reject SESSION_BUSY if any related queued or dispatchable Task, active Run, process, pending command/handoff/control, UNKNOWN effect or restore/recovery fence is not settled; no trusting --settled, no automatic pause/cancel, no waiting transaction holding a network call.

Recommended deterministic default semantics: every successful host.configure advances the principal host default version; supplying session_id additionally switches exactly that settled session. This satisfies the no-session default-only rule, gives HostStatus.config_revision an unambiguous default identity, and leaves all other existing sessions pinned. Record this interpretation in the future registered scope before implementation; do not infer a default from unordered history or add a frozen public field.

Atomically insert immutable configuration, CAS head, optionally CAS session model_config_ref and increment session control revision exactly once, invalidate pending permission context derived from old config by normal stale-input checks, persist completed typed ConfigureResult and command identity/idempotency receipt. Rejection rolls back all business changes via existing savepoint. No business Task/Run/effect is created by configuration.

Response COMPLETED means saved configuration only, verified_at null until an actual bound successful probe. Session top-level response revision reflects the committed session revision; host-level null scope stays null. Crash before commit leaves no mutation; crash after commit replays identical receipt. ACK/IN_PROGRESS/refusal/transport timeout do not trigger client adoption or a new command ID.

runtime_and_credential_binding.trusted_ports: Inject a host-owned ClientConfigurationAuthority into ClientService through API composition. It supplies verified local principal/client and provider credential metadata only, never plaintext; configuration service accepts no body-supplied trust flag. HostStatus queries DB configuration in current tx and vault status metadata at a stated check time. The separate RuntimeCoordinator ModelCredential path remains the only material source.
runtime_and_credential_binding.runtime_resolution: Add a trusted configuration-binding resolver that combines immutable selected config and an explicitly approved existing Mu execution template. Resolve provider base_url/model/ref/credential and runtime profile hashes from DB/host authority, not a task REPORT. New endpoints/model/config revision do not inherit a prior qualification. Until an exact binding passes currentRuntimeBinding/currentRuntimeAdmission, new session/run admission returns MODEL_UNAVAILABLE. host.configure may still save an unverified config; it must not automatically run qualification/provider.probe or mutate an accepted RuntimeRegistration/profile in place.
runtime_and_credential_binding.coordinator: Use existing coordinator scan/claim/dispatch, with canonical read-only derived routes for approved bindings; do not mutate shared Providers slices while workers run or start a second scheduler. At Task admission and Run claim freeze exact configuration/version/profile/route/core build/credential ref in the existing immutable dispatch manifest, and resolve provider requests by that original manifest plus canonical binding. Head changes affect only later turns. Historical Run verification resolves original versions, not current default or current mutable session.
runtime_and_credential_binding.qualification_gap: provider.probe/models product handlers are separately unfinished. This proposal does not implement or accept them implicitly. Existing real qualification workflow can supply exact trusted binding; product connection testing needs its own full scope and explicit resource authorization. Configuration completion cannot be represented as runtime qualification or LIVE provider success.
runtime_and_credential_binding.credential_intake: Before either native or in-process replacement, resolve prior ref under this verified OS-user host and require same provider/owner and non-revoked valid metadata. Serialize vault index/store/revoke transitions and define failure rollback so refusal does not revoke the old credential. Add no public credential read API; no scanning other directories. Existing records use their protected single-owner host directory as ownership, not a string supplied by caller.
runtime_and_credential_binding.revocation: Config stores a reference, not a validity promise. Protected metadata checks do not decrypt material. Runtime rechecks exact provider/ref/revocation at each original effect dispatch before network; define credential-borrow/start linearization with the same host synchronization so calls begun after revoke fail. Never substitute a newer credential ref, other project credential or another endpoint/model on failure. Already UNKNOWN effects are not reissued.
runtime_and_credential_binding.inventory: HostStatus bounded max100 model configurations and max100 credential summaries; use current default plus explicitly visible bounded inventory, preserve historical versions in DB regardless of display bound. Never infer missing credentials from an unreported/failed metadata provider. verified_at derives only from current exact successful probe identity, not configuration save time.

backup_restore_upgrade: Add model configuration tables to deterministic inventory/digest and private typed validation. Check immutable canonical bytes/hash, owner/revision unique head relationship, journal/replay target hashes, current session config refs and runtime binding refs against original canonical profile/qualification/dispatch. Preserve all historical versions. Forged public REPORT/media/produced_by fields never validate a config binding.

Portable restore retains configuration references/history but exports no vault material, wrapped bytes, connection tokens or credentials. Fresh provisioning yields a new credential_ref and explicit new configuration; it never rewrites historical configs or old effects. Current status reports MISSING/REVOKED until proven, and runtime admissions are fenced until current local authority revalidates.

Same-host22→23 upgrade is a new exact plan with source22+target23 release/migration hashes, protected existing4 opaque rows and versioned history, real drain, immutable source snapshot, isolated transaction, rollback, exact operational row preservation and old-writer rejection. Preserve original13/14/20/21→22 plans byte/semantics. Workspace preservation must be a new plan-specific guard; do not generalize existing21→22 exception.

Restore fencing remains independent of historical configuration truth: existing queue/dispatch/UNKNOWN/cancel receipts remain as originally observed, writer epochs advance only through current recovery, old process reports cannot write, and no restored config starts a model request. Exact restored credential refs do not authorize use of another host vault.

Test empty22, additive-client-schema present/absent, real22 configuration-free upgrade, active-workspace22 preservation, malformed/tampered references, interruption at staged migration/verification/commit, and backup/restore after multiple config versions with old Run still referencing its original version. Prove source DB and old migrations unchanged.
cli_contract: Read actual typed HostStatus config_revision and session snapshot for requested session; local file is a cache, not CAS authority. Send next revision, exact provider_id and model_id (split CLI provider/model once; preserve the remaining model string), base_url and optional credential_ref. No session requires no writer epoch; session change requires actual current writer snapshot. Local --settled/settle-run markers cannot establish backend settlement.

Use strict v2CallContext and ValidateResultAgainstMethod/typed ConfigureResult with original protocol/method/command/session identity. Adopt only COMPLETED and exact returned fields, model_config_ref and committed revision; do not ++ locally or accept arbitrary result objects. For response-loss retain original command ID/hash and expose pending reconciliation without new mutation.

Before atomically replacing local configuration, confirm the intended current host/session binding if an old receipt could have been superseded. Use full local file CAS to avoid overwriting concurrent CLI/Desktop cache changes; local-write failure reports host commit truth and reconciliation path, not rollback or a new host command. Preserve previous local bytes on pending/refusal/malformed response.

Configuration input remains usable without an existing session/settled Run. Native hidden-input credential import uses existing trusted OS transport and never CommandEnvelope/argv logs; do not create a parallel secret store. Existing Doctor reports host metadata and provider NOT_CHECKED until actual probe; no widening Doctor results.
scope_boundaries: These32 proposed paths are not authorized for edits. Several runtime paths overlap streaming19 and must wait for its integration/review and a fresh baseline. cli_v2 must inherit reviewed L01 unchanged HTTP behavior. No current parallel edits. No frozen schemas, migrations<=22, third_party SDK, Doctor files, S5 suffix, old legacy contract tests/receipts or canonical/registry edits. completion_gates: Real HTTP→domain→SQLite configure host0→1 + exact typed result, no Task/Run/effect/network; restart reads same configuration/ref/default/history.

Next-revision and session CAS races: one commit, loser explicit conflict; sameID exact replay1 mutation; changed payload/method/project/session with sameID conflict; legacy ambiguous keys fail without rewrite.

OWNER/local binding vs READER/remote/foreign client/project/credential/provider negatives; vault values never occur in journal/event/artifact/raw diagnostics. Credential replace failure preserves old record.

Busy matrix includes queued preclaim Task, active MODEL stream, pending STEER/FOLLOW_UP/handoff/cancel, stale lease, UNKNOWN effect/restore fence; all refuse configuration without changing default/session. Legitimate settled session moves once while all historical Run/profile hashes remain unchanged.

Trusted immutable runtime mapping: forged public REPORT/profile tags, unqualified or changed build/bundle/model/endpoint/credential and stale default fail; exact qualified path uses new config only nextRun, no auto fallback/retry. No network needed in architecture review; any future LIVE claim requires separate actual authorized evidence.

CLI actual typed complete vs ACK/IN_PROGRESS/rejected/malformed/lost response and local-write-CAS failure; no pending adoption, no local revision invention, host-level first-use works without fake settled Run.

Version23 fresh/22→23 upgrade/backup/restore positive and all tamper/fence/rollback boundaries, original schema21→22 and historical guards preserved. Per-source input/raw/tool freeze and independent source review precede Root integration; full W05/A04 acceptance remains separate.
open_before_implementation: Root must register chosen SQL23 and the explicit default+optional-session semantics after architecture review; this proposal is not source permission.
Exact legacy command-ID collision inventory must be evaluated against an authorized source snapshot during migration design; this review read no actual DB. Never silently backfill conflicts.
Connection probing and runtime qualification acceptance are independent gates; no synthetic control or configuration completion can satisfy LIVE evidence.
